news.title: Most Canadians oppose dual-practice health care, survey finds, as Alberta defends controversial new law  - The Hill Times
news.description: Alberta’s Bill 11, which will take effect in September, allows doctors to provide some public and private services simultaneously. But a new survey finds that 56 per cent of Albertans are against the legislation, and only 34 per cent in support.
